cues: Before guests arrive, she arranges favorite novels by color along the study wall, leaving titles easy to browse.
After moving in, he realizes his growing collection needs a dedicated place beside his desk.
In a quiet reading room, students return borrowed volumes to their labeled places after afternoon study sessions.
During spring cleaning, dusting around rows of hardcovers reveals a forgotten bookmark tucked behind an atlas.
At bedtime, a parent lets each child choose a story from the family collection near the armchair.
The historian keeps frequently consulted dictionaries and reference works close at hand in the home office.
